Do courses carry different credit hours,: Yes. Every course has credit hours, a whole number from 1 to 6, and the GPA is weighted by them: add up grade point times credit hours over all the student's courses and divide by the total credit hours.
What GPA does a student with no scores h: Show 0 until they have a score.
Do failed courses count in the GPA?: Yes, an F counts as 0.0 with its full credit hours.
